spanish: Y si buey embistente él desde ayer anteayer, y fue amonestado en sus dueños, y no lo guarda, y mata varón o mujer, el buey será apedreado, y también su dueño será muerto.
grammarChanges: "morirán" (3rd plural, active qal sense) repaired to "será muerto" (3rd singular, hophal passive) to match יוּמָת.
"sus dueños" repaired to "su dueño" in this clause only, for subject-verb agreement with the now-singular "será muerto"; the earlier, non-cited "en sus dueños" was left untouched.
readerNote: בְּעָלָיו is a plural-form noun with a singular owner referent; since the verb יוּמָת is singular, I kept the verb singular and matched the noun to it in this clause rather than keeping the noun plural, which would have left subject and verb disagreeing in Spanish.
